01 / THE CHALLENGE

The challenge

Early teams need visibility across leads, partners and service readiness. When that information is scattered, founder reviews become a bottleneck.

02 / THE APPROACH

The approach

Built CRM trackers, KPI dashboards and SOPs across customer and partner journeys. Tracked requirements, next steps and adoption blockers while onboarding 11 healthcare and eldercare partners.

03 / WHAT CHANGED

What changed

Reduced founder review time by 80%. Supported the first paid cohort through lead tracking, partner coordination and service-readiness checks, and built a caregiver community of more than 200 members.
